title: リスニング 第2回（単語・入試問題・お話）

chapters.title: パート1 単語・例文
パート2 入試の形の問題

words.ex: What do you want to be in the future?
words.exja: あなたは将来、何になりたいですか。

words.ex: Please tell me the reason you were late.
words.exja: あなたが遅れた理由を教えてください。

words.ex: Let's share our ideas in the group.
words.exja: グループで考えを共有しましょう。

words.ex: We worked together to solve the problem.
words.exja: 私たちはその問題を解決するために協力しました。

words.ex: I wonder what he is doing now.
words.exja: 彼は今、何をしているのかな。

words.ex: I spent my summer vacation with my cousins.
words.exja: 私は夏休みをいとこたちと過ごしました。

words.ex: How many languages can you speak?
words.exja: あなたはいくつの言語を話せますか。

words.ex: We visited a local farm last weekend.
words.exja: 私たちは先週末、地元の農場を訪ねました。

words.ex: You can get a lot of information from books.
words.exja: 本からたくさんの情報を得ることができます。

words.ex: I practice every day to improve my English.
words.exja: 私は英語を上達させるために毎日練習しています。
私はスポーツが好きで、特にサッカーが好きです。

words.ex: I want to study abroad someday.
words.exja: 私はいつか留学したいです。

words.ex: The event will be held next Sunday.
words.exja: そのイベントは次の日曜日に開かれます。

words.ex: Thank you for your advice. It was very helpful.
words.exja: アドバイスをありがとう。とても役に立ちました。

words.ex: My goal is to win the tournament this year.
words.exja: 私の目標は、今年の大会で優勝することです。

words.ja: 伝えたいこと、メッセージ
words.ex: What is the message of his speech?
words.exja: 彼のスピーチで伝えたいことは何ですか。

lines: Hello, this is Emma. I'm calling about our plan for Saturday. I'm sorry, but I can't go to the movie in the morning because I have to help my grandmother. Can we go in the afternoon instead? The movie starts at two. Please call me back.
c: To ask her friend to help her grandmother.
To change the time to go to the movie.
To say the movie was not interesting.
questions.why: 「午前は行けないので、午後にしてもいい？」と言っています。映画に行く時間を変えたくて電話しました。

lines: How was your trip to Tokyo, Yuki?
It was fun. I went there with my family last month.
We visited a museum on the first day and went shopping on the second day. I wanted to see a baseball game, but it was canceled because of the rain.
questions.q: What did Yuki do on the second day?
questions.why: 1日目は博物館、2日目は買い物です。野球は雨で中止になったので見ていません。

lines: Hello, everyone. Last summer, I worked as a volunteer at a nursing home. At first, I was nervous because I didn't know what to talk about. But an old woman there smiled and told me stories about her childhood. I learned that listening is also a way to help people. Now I visit her every month.
c: Talking a lot is the best way to help people.
Listening is also a way to help people.
Old people don't like to talk.
Working as a volunteer is easy.
questions.why: I learned that listening is also a way to help people.「聞くことも人を助ける方法だと学んだ」。スピーチの問題では I learned や I think のあとが大事です。

lines: Ken, what are you going to do during the winter vacation?
I'm going to study hard for the entrance exam. I also want to read some English books.
That's a good idea. Which book will you read first?
I haven't decided yet. Can you give me some advice?
questions.q: Answer the question in English. What does Ken want to do during the winter vacation besides studying?
questions.a: He wants to read some English books.
questions.why: 英語で答える問題です。I also want to read some English books. と言っているので、He wants to read some English books. と、主語を He に、want を wants に変えて答えます。

stories.title: The Lost Map
stories.text: One Sunday, I was waiting for a bus at the station. A man with a big bag was looking at a map. He looked worried. I wanted to help him, but I didn't know what to say. Then I remembered my teacher's words: "Use the English you know." I said, "Can I help you?" The man said, "I want to go to the castle." I showed him the right bus and said, "This bus goes to the castle." He smiled and said, "Thank you so much." It was a small thing, but I felt very happy. My English helped someone that day.
stories.ja: 駅で地図を見て困っている外国の男性に、勇気を出して Can I help you? と声をかけた話。先生の「知っている英語を使いなさい」という言葉を思い出し、お城へ行くバスを教えてあげた。小さなことだけど、自分の英語がだれかの役に立って、とてもうれしかった。
